case: MHM weak-symmetry elasticity, oscillatory Young modulus, M2AN 55 (2021), Section 6.1.2/Table 3

physical_data.geometry: unit square; diagonal macrotriangles with original physical fine-cell connectivity
physical_data.boundary: exact displacement trace, including nonzero values

method.native: DOLFINx/UFL/Basix, monolithic weak-symmetry stress/displacement/rotation with native PETSc/MUMPS LU
method.restriction: Independent Basix normal-moment interpolation restricts interior macroface tractions to the declared segmented degree; fine exterior normal degree and all declared interior stress and DG displacement/rotation modes are retained. The congruence-restricted operator represents the same MHM approximation spaces. DOLFINx assembles the conforming operator; the independent comparison application supplies the macro restriction and enriched coordinates, without a built-in DOLFINx MHM controller.
method.assembly: Matching physical Duffy quadrature under native cell permutations; independent UFL compliance, divergence, weak symmetry, body force and displacement boundary load.
method.field_norms: Physical stress Frobenius, displacement vector and rotation scalar L2; independent orders10/12, retaining every one-sided fine-cell value.
method.acceptance: Native original restricted-equation residual <1e-10 and each same-space physical relative field difference <1e-8, without tolerance changes.
